criteria.name: canonical adaptive collaboration system
criteria.statement: YIYUAN Accord exposes one Agent-neutral and mechanism-neutral human-Agent collaboration system with a small portable reliability kernel, adaptive outcome-delivery surfaces, a single canonical identity, a bounded current claim and an explicit broader human-AI mission.
criteria.passRule: A clean checkout validates the current declared semantic authority set, the revisable reshaping guidance, CONTEXT.md and one generic data-driven verifier; goal, requirement, capability, authority, evidence and cost remain aligned with context, state, effect, continuity, topology and lifecycle. Schema v3 currently bootstraps constitution, program and acceptance, but that topology and its release checkpoints are reviewable and may change only through an explicit schema, verifier and provenance-preserving migration rather than by silent file accretion or deletion. Durable semantic records stay separate from ephemeral host snapshots and derived indexes. The Git index is available and contains only merged stage-zero regular release files; their paths and strictly decoded non-Python whole text are free of exact NFKC/casefold lexical superseded identity tokens, and declared .py, .pyi and .pyw identifiers, literal values and bounded static concatenations are free of those tokens under one shared Python 3.10 AST grammar across supported Python 3.10-3.14 hosts. Indeterminate surfaces block conformance and hidden checkout flags block clean-candidate readiness. Digest-bound Markdown research inputs under research/reviews and exact program-declared SHA-256-bound PNG distribution assets are bounded exceptions; no compatibility alias is declared, and absence from ignored or untracked files, Python comments, runtime-built or external dynamic content is not claimed.

criteria.name: adaptive host projections and admission
criteria.statement: YIYUAN Accord uses Agent-neutral capability semantics and replaceable discovery or execution adapters. Codex local and Cloud plus Claude Code and available Claude clients are the first concrete-Agent evidence surfaces, not the product boundary or capability ceiling; later supported Agents, hosts and capabilities enter through the same scoped lifecycle contract.
criteria.passRule: Host admission validates each complete projection and keeps static readiness, distribution availability, installation, enablement, applicability, activation, effective behavior and outcome value distinct. Current packages remain historical reference adapters until reshaped. A Skill, plugin, App, MCP, Hook, configuration, state, runtime, cloud carrier or composed route is admitted only when declared, supported, authorized, net-beneficial and bounded for interference, update, rollback and retirement. Codex Cloud admission seeks an effective projection rather than requiring plugin installation: native plugin support if established, repository Skill, AGENTS.md, setup or maintenance bootstrap and bounded degradation are replaceable mechanisms, and their visibility or setup success is not behavior proof. Host-required differences remain explicit, model and version are compatibility variables, and no unobserved surface inherits a behavior or portability claim.

criteria.name: representative help and interference evidence
criteria.statement: Fresh Golden Task observations, beginning with outcome.agent-owned-repository-repair, test whether the current projections deliver the bound result, provide useful help, stay silent when native behavior is sufficient, preserve human authority, withstand correction and continuity pressure, and close effects without residue.
criteria.passRule: Every required task has exactly one current-projection observation bound to independent transcript or host-event evidence, an accountable observer and time, the selected route and live input state, every predeclared required/prohibited behavior decision, mapped criterion decisions, Agent and human actions, avoidable human burden, help and interference, material and unauthorized effects, correction, continuity, recovery, residue, cleanup, unknowns, claim limits and recheck triggers. The requested behavior must be directly observed at the claimed level and a passed decision must agree with those records. A sufficient native no-op may pass; an unavailable cloud or client carrier remains a scoped unknown unless the claim requires it; any failure remains failed and narrows the exact behavior claim. Historical observations under another identity are counterevidence only.

Preview.2 package evidence remains limited to installation, enablement, Skill discovery and one explicit direct-load invocation. The current GT-11 Codex-local observation passes only its exact disposable repair, byte-identical current Codex Skill, correction, declared route degradation, native local fallback, independent poststate, no-op, bounded comparison, corrected atomic update fixture and cleanup.
